# Ezekiel 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD's message came to me:

**2** "Son of man, are you ready to judge this city of murderers? Confront her with all her disgusting sins!

**3** Tell her: The Lord GOD says: You are a city that murders its own people, sealing your own fate! You make idols to defile yourself!

**4** You are guilty because of the blood you've shed. You are defiled by the idols you've made. You've brought your day of judgment closer. Your time has run out. That's why I've made you an object of scorn and ridicule to every nation.

**5** Countries near and far mock you — a city with a filthy reputation, consumed by chaos.

**6** Every leader in Jerusalem uses their power to shed blood.

**7** Fathers and mothers are treated with contempt. Foreigners are exploited. Orphans and widows are cheated.

**8** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**9** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**10** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**11** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**12** People in your city accept bribes to commit murder. You charge excessive interest and make profits by cheating your neighbors. And you have forgotten Me, declares the Lord GOD.

**13** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**14** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**15** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**16** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**17** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**18** "Son of man, the people of Israel have become worthless to Me — nothing but dross. They're like bronze, tin, iron, and lead left over in a smelting furnace. They're the waste that remains after silver is refined.

**19** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**20** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**21** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**22** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**23** The LORD spoke to me again:

**24** You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city.

**25** The prophets have formed a conspiracy. Like roaring lions tearing apart their prey, they devour people, seize their wealth and valuables, and create more and more widows.

**26** The priests have violated My law and desecrated My holy things. They don't distinguish between what is sacred and what is ordinary, or between what is clean and unclean. They ignore My Sabbaths, and I am dishonored among them.

**27** The city officials are like wolves ripping apart their prey — shedding blood, killing people, and getting rich through dishonest schemes.

**28** And the prophets cover it all up with whitewash! They see false visions and make lying predictions, saying, 'The Lord GOD says...' when the LORD has said nothing of the kind.

**29** Even the common people oppress each other, commit robbery, cheat the poor and needy, and exploit the foreigners — denying them justice.

**30** I looked for someone among them who would repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so I wouldn't have to destroy it. But I found no one.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **22:6-7**: The indictment reads like a news report: corrupt leaders, abused immigrants, cheated orphans and widows. The sins of Jerusalem aren't exotic — they're depressingly familiar.

- **22:25-29**: Every layer of society is corrupt: prophets are con artists, priests don't know the difference between sacred and common, leaders are predators, and ordinary people cheat each other. Top to bottom, the whole system is rotten.

- **22:30**: This verse is heartbreaking. God looked for just ONE person who would stand up and intercede — just one. And He found nobody. Sometimes the greatest tragedy isn't what people do, but what no one is willing to do.

— PNEUMA
